name: ácido - [MMMM]
description:
A dano so nice, it burns you twice. ácido dano hurts you, but it also eats through your equipment if you're not careful. Any adventurer who has had the misfortune to come face-to-face with a Black Ooze can tell you that. Magical equipment can generally recover from this dano...but dammit Jim, I'm a plague doctor, not a blacksmith. I stitch flesh, not clothing. You will have look to other expertise if you want your
belongings repaired.

results.description:
ácido has splashed over both of your eyes. Você está &Reference[blinded]{blinded} and both your eyes are não funcional. If you do not receive Tratamento dentro de 30 minutos your vision will be permanently ausente.

Tratamento - A DC 20 Save Sense Surgery
results.name: Ocular Corrosion

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.iP8lOROAIYARwcgk]{Large membro Table (Tabela de Membros Maiores)}. ácido coats seu membro, and you hear the sizzle as it starts to dissolve. This membro is não funcional. If you do not receive Tratamento dentro de 30 minutos, O membro dissolves away and is ausente.

Tratamento - A DC 20 Save membro Surgery. You get 1 check for this surgery; if you do not meet the DC on the first check, O membro is lost.
results.name: Dissolved membro

results.description:
Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.vG8gsjqxGB7y9cSD]{Small apêndice Table (Tabela de Apêndices Menores)}. ácido splashes over seu apêndice and sizzles as it begins to dissolve. This apêndice is não funcional. If you do not receive Tratamento dentro de 30 minutos, O apêndice dissolves away and is ausente.

Tratamento - A DC 20 Save membro Surgery. You get 1 check for this surgery; if you do not meet the DC on the first check, O apêndice is lost.
results.name: Dissolved apêndice

results.description: Your weapon has been coated in corrosive ácido and is getting duller by the second. Each round your weapon takes a cumulative -1 to dano Rolls. When a mundane weapon reaches a -5 penalty it is destroyed. When a magic weapon reaches a -5 penalty all magical effects are suppressed for [[1d4]] dias (after which the penalty disappears and the weapon functions normally).
results.name: Corroded Weapon

results.description:
Any friendly character you touch or otherwise interact with physically takes ácido dano equal to your level. Creatures you grapple take this dano at the beginning of their Turno. This effect lasts 1 minute.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 15]] check ends this effect. You may reattempt this check.
results.name: Caustic Coating

results.description:
The ácido has left you with a superficial, but painful queimadura. You take 1 point of ácido dano per 5 feet of movement while on initiative.

Tratamento - A [[/skill medicine 13]] check ends this effect.
results.name: Caustic queimadura

results.description: Your arcane focus or spell component pouch is dissolved and destroyed. If your arcane focus is magical, it instead has its magical effects suppressed for [[1d4]] dias and is unusable during that time.
results.name: Dissolved Arcane Medium

results.description: Your shield is dissolved and destroyed. If your shield is magical, it instead has its magical effects suppressed for [[1d4]] dias and is unusable during that time.
results.name: Dissolved Shield

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. Você tem a silvery white speckled cicatriz as a result of ácido splashing on that area of your body.
results.name: Dappled cicatriz

results.description: Your clothes have been corroded to the point of uselessness. If they are magic, they instead have any magical effects suppressed for [[1d4]] dias. Você está luckily unharmed, apart from a potentially awkward situation with your party members.
results.name: Corroded Clothes

results.description: You've inhaled the ácido's toxic fumes causing you to cough and hack violently. Você está &Reference[incapacitated]{incapacitated} até the end of your next Turno.
results.name: Toxic Inhalation

results.description: You've deeply inhaled the ácido's toxic fumes causing you to go into a coughing fit. Você está &Reference[incapacitated]{incapacitated} for [[1d4]] rodadas.
results.name: Caustic Lung

results.description: Role na @UUID[Compendium.mmm.mmmm-pt-BR.RollTable.5EyNHyXKtfhIlYCa]{cicatriz Chart (Tabela de Cicatrizes)}. The ácido injury has resulted in a cicatriz that is gnarled and scaly with a light sheen the same color as the ácido that damaged you. Você recebe +2 Natural Armor from it, or +1 if you already have a Natural Armor bonus.
results.name: Scaly cicatriz

results.description: The ácido has covered your armor, slowly eating away at it. Each Turno your armor takes a cumulative -1 penalty to AC. When the armor's AC reaches 10, it is destroyed. If the armor is magical, its magical effects are instead suppressed for [[1d6]] dias and it is unusable during this time (after which the penalty disappears and the armor functions normally).
results.name: Corroded Armor

results.description: ácido has eaten into the essence of one of your magic items, expelling its arcane energy and rendering it mundane. Choose a magic item on your person at random. That item loses all magical effects permanently. If the item's rarity is Legendary or Artifact, its magical effects are instead suppressed for [[3d6]] dias (and return to normal after this period).
results.name: Dissolved Magic

results.description:
The ácido's caustic fumes have wreaked havoc on your vocal cords. Your voice is não funcional and Você está mute. If you do not receive Tratamento dentro de 30 minutos it will be permanently ausente.

Tratamento - A DC 19 Save Sense Surgery
results.name: Corroded Vocal Cords
